description: Two or three color schemes for the link page from a photo: Light, Dark, and Bold when the photo has a strong color. Pass media_id (a ready photo from media_list) or profile: true (the page's photo, else the first connected account's). Every scheme reads with no design warnings and never uses a tan background. Nothing is saved: show them, and apply one with bio_page_update { design: { colors } } (on a gradient background also set background.style "solid", or color2 to match).

profile.description: Use the page's photo, else the first connected account's

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: bio_colors_from_photo
title: Color schemes from a photo
